entries.name: 近代侦察编制
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE production game technology icon, 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuinely transparent RGBA outside the hexagonal badge.
Input 1 is the existing cold-steel technology badge, an edit target for its visual frame and style. Input 2 is the exact approved industrial building, the subject reference.
Replace ONLY the building and its diorama inside input 1 with the building in input 2. Preserve the upright point-top silver brushed-steel double-bevel hexagonal frame, charcoal faceted inset, isometric strategy-game PBR illustration style, soft upper-left lighting, and exactly THREE small cyan-blue faceted rank crystals with dark metal/brass settings in the same lower left, lower center, lower right triangular positions. Preserve consistent readable crystal silhouettes. No other gems. Remove all cavalry-specific shields, horseshoes, spears, medieval purple roofs from the first image. Subject appearance and palette come ONLY from the second image.
Building should fill the inset clearly, leave a little breathing room to all six frame edges. Fit its whole roof, base and essential architecture without cropping. Keep complete steel rim with about 12 pixels transparent margin at top/bottom. No shadow outside the badge, no scenery outside badge, no people, no text, no digits, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no checkerboard pixels or opaque background. The black inset is opaque; only exterior is alpha-transparent.
Do not invent extra buildings or redesign the approved silhouette. Simplify only tiny repeated clutter for small-icon legibility. This is an icon, not a screenshot, collage, sprite sheet or presentation.
Key subject: pale weathered stone and timber scout post, grey standing-seam pitched metal roof, small brass compass medallion on roof, one wooden observation tower on the left with ladder and railing, attached right lean-to with sandbags, low rough-stone base. Preserve the modest small compass, not an oversized emblem; clear scout-tower silhouette.
